series_key: implementing a breakeven mechanism in mql5
mechanism: CBreakEvenAtr sets price_to_beat and breakeven_price as open ± ATR[idx]*multipliers (activation multiplier < offset multiplier). CBreakEvenRR activates when price travels coefficient_rr × |open−SL| and can offset BE by ATR*mult or fixed points. Selector CBreakEven switches ATR/RRR/fixed modes. ATR here senses local volatility to scale risk-management triggers.
data_needed: iATR handle/period/TF; open price, SL; position tickets via OnTradeTransaction
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Order Blocks EA testbed; ATR timeframe/period configurable per symbol
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-adaptive trigger distances (ATR×mult, RRR×initial risk) are reusable MIS features for when structure/risk states should update under changing vol.
quote: fixed points are not used either for the distance at which breakeven is activated or for the difference between the breakeven price and the position opening price. Instead, multipliers applied to the ATR value are used.
